summary: The note describes Phu Kradueng, a mountain 1316 m high in Loei Province, Thailand. It lies in Phu Kradueng District, which takes its name from the mountain, and its western side borders Nam Nao District of Phetchabun Province. The mountain is part of the Phetchabun Mountains, a massif that forms a natural boundary between North Thailand and Isan.
one_line: Phu Kradueng is a 1316 m mountain in Loei Province, Thailand, part of the Phetchabun Mountains.
